# 失业后，他做出一摊子工具月入$1万

**Original URL:** https://www.indiehackers.com/post/CiXnqXRQSDchBZOhUoS7

## 冷启动：创业公司倒了他没倒

![封面图](https://storage.googleapis.com/indie-hackers.appspot.com/post-images/CiXnqXRQSDchBZOhUoS7/PWairgiOpneHvkGJri7RVbtORKI2/Dan_Kulkov.png)

Dan 做 indie hacking 3年了。

Worked for startup ran out of VC money。

所以需要找新的工作。

那时，indie hacking 和 solopreneurship 在 Twitter 上很火。

所以他决定尝试 very simple idea：

Directory of tools with great free plans。

Can help founders launch and grow businesses。

他需要这个，所以想象 others might too。

Goal was to make first $1 online。

To prove to himself it was possible。

And it worked。

Since then，launched five products。

Experimented with different types of businesses：

Content products、directories、services、SaaS。

有些成功，有些 never took off。

## 反直觉：别人追风口，他追痛苦

MakerBox：Content products and services around marketing。

Generated ~$130K in 3 years。

FounderPal：AI-powered marketing platform。

Generated ~$215K in 2 years。

Lead Magnet Examples：Collection of lead magnet keywords。

Generated ~$1K in 1 month (new product)。

Sponsor This Newsletter：Directory of newsletters open to sponsorships。

Generated ~$20K before getting acquired。

Smooz：Post-purchase platform。

Generated $0。

Currently generating roughly $10K/mo from three remaining businesses。

## 暴击：Smooz教他认清现实

Biggest challenge is always not to fall into trap of building tool nobody needs。

Had this experience while building Smooz。

Needed this platform for himself。

To improve post-purchase experience of content products：

Delivering files easily、collecting data about customers、upselling products and services。

But turned out this problem was only relevant to very small number of users。

Ideal customers needed to sell with LemonSqueezy and have consistent revenue。

And he also had to persuade them that current post-purchase flow could be improved。

Required outreach、calls、onboarding。

Bad fit with $9/mo platform。

Eventually，had to accept product flopped and stop wasting time on it。

If could start over on Smooz。

Would run 10-15 user interviews。

Understand market and problem better before building anything。

This simple step would have saved month of development。

##  punchline：别指望2周就成功

His advice：Try more things！

Solopreneurship is not easy。

Nothing will work on first try。

Marketing channels will stop working。

Your audience will ignore you。

He can't stress this enough — just try different things。

Product Hunt launch failed？

Okay，do some cold emails。

No response？

Conduct some interviews。

Found pain point？

Build free tool for it。

Iterate-iterate-iterate。

Please，don't expect micro-SaaS to earn $5,000/mo after 2 weeks of publishing blog posts。

It's long run。

Some months will be plateau。

Until you find out what's working。

Sometimes might even need to start again。

Maybe product launched is good enough to earn $500/mo。

But not $5,000/mo。

This is part of journey。

**Do boring stuff：**

Ask for feedback。

Ship good things。

Iterate。

Be consistent。
